# T-4: Validate regression evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make test-result-review and gate-impl mechanically verify project regression evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-result-review requires project_regression_verification pass.
- failed or invalid test-result-review does not mark the step done and remains retryable.
- registry post-hooks mark test-result-review done only after deterministic validation and pass verdict.
- flow-level integration gate-impl rejects missing, stale, failed, or unverifiable required regression.
- run-impl-confirm next-step guidance cannot point directly to review before test-execute and test-result-review.
- impl review changes reset downstream test artifacts or gate instructions direct rerun of test-execute.
- task-level gate-impl does not require project regression artifacts.
- manual set-step cannot mark post-hook-managed test/gate steps done without valid current artifacts.
- gate-impl does not compare base branch test behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Share deterministic validator logic between run-test-result-review.js and run-gate.js where practical. Keep schema files inside the local schema subset and put membership, marker, freshness, and cross-field checks in code. Update registry post-hooks so failed/invalid test-result-review does not complete the step.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for pass, fail, missing check, stale changed_files, targeted path mismatch, and required=false category validation.
